g.text: SAMPLE REVIEW EXERCISE / NOT A CREDENTIAL
Fictional reviewer: Alex Sample · Training workspace only
Use this page only to exercise these controls:
01 Submit a specific competence and its expiry date.
02 Ask an organizer to check the supporting source.
03 Record an inspection against one published plan version.
04 State the limitations and keep the original private.
This fictional document proves no training, professional license,
insurance, building compliance or safe equipment operation.
A sample sign-off must always remain labelled sample.
Actual work needs a qualified person to inspect the real site within their scope.
Photos and payment records cannot replace ventilation, electrical or laser checks.
